h: Antonio Conte reportedly in contact with Manchester United over the manager job
p: Reports say Manchester United have made initial contact over Antonio Conte as a possible replacement for Michael Carrick. Conte is said to be ready to start immediately, though the club has not confirmed any talks. Other names, including Eddie Howe, have also been linked.
more: Carrick is reportedly still backed by the board for now.
Another poor result could change the picture, according to the reports.
